# Search

## Search

A `search` landmark holding the field frame, a decorative leading
magnifier and a clear action. The field draws no visible label - the
primary's own search label is visually hidden - so `label` and
`accessibilityLabel` name the input directly (default `Search`), and no
`aria-labelledby` is emitted. Escape is the field's own contract: it
clears a populated field, or asks an expandable owner to collapse an
empty one.

### Semantics

The input carries the `searchbox` role; the root is the `search`
landmark. The clear mounts hidden and untabbable while the field is
empty, and one action slot is reserved on each side of the text whether
or not it shows. The collapsed expandable trigger expands on press,
Enter or Space - never on focus alone - and focus moves to the input on
open and back to the trigger after an Escape collapse.

### ExpandableSearch

`ExpandableSearch` opens the field from the icon action; the second
system has no expandable search element, so its values are a Superloom
decision - the roster's `superloom_decision` flag. Its disabled icon
reads the indicator's disabled leaf, as the expandable member does, not
the plain search's on-color-disabled.

### SearchSkeleton

`SearchSkeleton` draws the search field's placeholder box at the field's
size with no label placeholder; the second system has no skeleton, so
its values are a Superloom decision - the roster's `superloom_decision`
flag.

### Uncarried variants

`xs` size (the field scale keeps `sm`/`md`/`lg`), `small` (deprecated
alias), `light` (deprecated upstream; `surface` is this library's
answer), `renderIcon` (the magnifier is the theme's `search` glyph; a
custom icon is not a Search), `role` (deprecated upstream; the input's
`searchbox` role is fixed), `closeButtonLabelText` (the clear's name is
the contract's `Clear search input`), `expandable`'s `isExpanded`
naming (ours is `expanded`), `onExpand`'s callback signature.

## ExpandableSearch

ExpandableSearch opens a search field from an icon action; the second system has no expandable search element, so its values are a Superloom decision.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | `anatomy.field_action` |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state`, `press` |
| Flags | `superloom_decision` - anatomy or a value decided here, not measured from a reference |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | no | The control's name; names the trigger and the input. Default `Search`. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name when `label` is absent. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | no | Hint shown in the empty field once expanded. Default `Search`. |
| `value` | `string` | no | Controlled value. Absent: the field keeps its own value, starting at `defaultValue` or empty. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | no | Initial uncontrolled value; applied once. |
| `onChangeText` | `function` | no | Called with the next text on every change. |
| `onClear` | `function` | no | Called when the clear action or Escape empties the field. |
| `onSubmit` | `function` | no | Called with the current text on submission. |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | no | Controlled open state. Absent: the control keeps its own state, starting collapsed. |
| `onExpandedChange` | `function` | no | Called with the next open state on every expand or collapse. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `variants`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Default `md`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the control and announces it as disabled. |
| `surface` | `string` | no | Color leaf of the surface the expanded field sits on. Default: config `FIELD_SURFACE`, else `background`. |
| `onFocus` | `function` | no | Called when the input gains focus. |
| `onBlur` | `function` | no | Called when the input loses focus. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the control. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `height` | `control.field_height` |
| `heightSmall` | `size.size_small` |
| `heightLarge` | `size.size_large` |
| `iconSize` | `control.field_icon_size` |
| `actionInset` | `control.field_action_inset` |
| `actionSize` | `control.field_action_size` |
| `actionGap` | `control.field_action_gap` |
| `squareRadius` | `shape.radius_00` |
| `roundRadius` | `shape.radius_max` |

Color leaves accepted: `background`, `layer_01`, `layer_02`, `layer_03`.

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| collapsed | `{"label":"Search"}` |
| expanded | `{"label":"Search","expanded":true}` |
| filled expanded | `{"label":"Search","value":"Query","expanded":true}` |
| disabled collapsed | `{"label":"Search","disabled":true}` |

## Search

Search is an accessibly named search field with a magnifier and a clear action.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | `anatomy.field_action` |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state`, `press`, `keyboard` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | no | The control's name; the search field draws no visible label, so it names the input. Default `Search`. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name when `label` is absent. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | no | Hint shown in the empty field. Default `Search`. |
| `value` | `string` | no | Controlled value. Absent: the field keeps its own value, starting at `defaultValue` or empty. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | no | Initial uncontrolled value; applied once. |
| `onChangeText` | `function` | no | Called with the next text on every change. |
| `onClear` | `function` | no | Called when the clear action or Escape empties the field. |
| `onSubmit` | `function` | no | Called with the current text on submission. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `variants`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Default `md`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Makes the field read-only, draws the disabled colors and announces it as disabled. |
| `surface` | `string` | no | Color leaf of the surface the field sits on; a floating label occludes the border with it. Default: config `FIELD_SURFACE`, else `background`. |
| `onFocus` | `function` | no | Called when the input gains focus. |
| `onBlur` | `function` | no | Called when the input loses focus. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the input. |

### Metrics

| `heightLarge` | `size.size_large` |
| `radius` | `control.field_radius` |
| `iconSize` | `control.field_icon_size` |
| `actionInset` | `control.field_action_inset` |
| `actionSize` | `control.field_action_size` |
| `actionGap` | `control.field_action_gap` |
| `squareRadius` | `shape.radius_00` |
| `roundRadius` | `shape.radius_max` |
| `edgeWidth` | `border.width_01` |

Color leaves accepted: `background`, `layer_01`, `layer_02`, `layer_03`.

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"label":"Search"}` |
| filled | `{"label":"Search","value":"Query"}` |
